name: WindowFrame
description:
The presentational parts of a window: `Root`, `AppBar` (icon, title, scope, actions and
controls), `Body`, `StatusBar` with `StatusItem`, `StatusMeta` and `StatusGroup` (a live
region), and `Controls`. It holds no window state; the workspace and pop-out wire it to
the manager.

slots.name: Root
slots.signature: ({ focused, state, material, className, children, ...rest }: WindowFrameRootProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: focused
props.description: The focused window has a stronger edge; others dim their app bar.

props.name: material
props.description:
`panel` (default): a glass frame, for secondary windows. `none`: no frame, for the
primary window, whose header, tabs and status sit on the canvas and whose content
panels carry the glass.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled view state, including loading, empty and error states.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).

slots.name: Controls
slots.signature: ({ title, maximised, onPopOut, fullscreen, onToggleFullscreen, onMinimise, onToggleMaximise, onClose, onReturn, compact, leading, }: WindowControlsProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: compact
props.description: Phones: minimise reads as "back to workspace" and maximise is implicit.

props.name: fullscreen
props.description: Whether the window is in full screen: the control reads "Exit full screen".

props.name: leading
props.description: Extra controls before the standard ones (the phone window switcher).

props.name: maximised
props.description: Whether the window fills its available workspace.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the person presses Close; run close guards before removing the window. The button is shown only when this is supplied.

props.name: onMinimise
props.description: Called when the person presses Minimise. The button is shown only when this is supplied.

props.name: onPopOut
props.description: Called when the person presses Pop out. The button is shown only when this is supplied and not `compact`.

props.name: onReturn
props.description: Popped-out windows offer "Return to workspace" in place of pop-out.

props.name: onToggleFullscreen
props.description: Called when the person presses Full screen or Exit full screen. The button is shown only when this is supplied and not `compact`.

props.name: onToggleMaximise
props.description: Called when the person presses Maximise or Restore (per `maximised`). The button is shown only when this is supplied and not `compact`.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading or title content.
